title: Lack of explanation or response
summary: This topic centers on customers saying that issues or expectations were not clearly explained and that they struggled to get replies or help.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe disappointment that important information was not mentioned and frustration that eSIM-related help was not provided.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention absent replies or unclear explanations about cold-weather range and a key failure, but the excerpts alone do not make the overall sentiment certain.

limitations: The sample is very small, so examples are insufficient to support broader conclusions.
This topic mixes customer support responsiveness with product-information gaps and isolated technical issues, so the cluster is not fully coherent.
Most sampled fragments are undetermined, which limits confidence in a single clear sentiment reading for the topic.
